lead.description: a contrast between the outcomes of the same units under two actions

overview_sentence: [Causality](articles/causality.qmd) is a contrast of outcomes under two actions.

self_checks.title: How many people differ
self_checks.prompt: Five people have treatment outcomes 1, 0, 1, 1, 0 and untreated outcomes 0, 0, 1, 0, 0. How many individual effects are nonzero?

self_checks.title: Corrected mean
self_checks.prompt: The third untreated outcome is changed from 1 to 0, and the treated mean stays 0.6. What is the average causal effect?
self_checks.answer: The untreated mean is 0, so the average causal effect is 0.6.
